title: Contractibility modulo orientation-preserving isometries of unit-weight pseudocircle realization spaces of finite rank-three chirotopes
author: Michael Gene Dobbins
difficulty_reason: The cited topological representation and Kneser theorems do not produce a continuous deformation on the oriented realization quotient. The author builds continuous canonical coordinates, modifies Kneser's deformation to respect precomposition by isometries, and proves that cellwise conformal interpolation depends continuously on pseudocircle boundaries. These compatibility arguments make the final quotient contraction well defined on the fixed unit-weight finite chirotope subspace.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. The oriented-chirotope part of Theorem2.7.1 restricted to finite rank3 chirotopes with every nonloop weight fixed to1 and every loop weight0, quotient by SO(3), using the exact weighted Frechet topology. Full author canonical-coordinate/equivariant Kneser/interpolation/continuity construction and final contraction read. Rado/Caratheodory disk parametrization, Kneser deformation retraction and topological representation theorem are explicit cited existing research foundations. Fixed weights are essential here: the printed rho on24 changes only the pseudocircle positions and otherwise retains reference A weights, so it is a contraction exactly on this fixed-weight subspace; no unsupplied weight interpolation is inserted. Fixed chirotope keeps compatible orientation of the three boundary vertices chosen in the authored conformal construction; no unoriented/reflection extension or infinite-index realization space claimed. No Stiefel/global Grassmannian retraction or classifying-space corollary counted separately.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: Continuously chosen Rado disk parametrizations, cellwise interpolation and an equivariant Kneser sphere-homeomorphism contraction overcome the universality pathologies of linear oriented-matroid realizations.
